GitHub Pages Publishing Workflow コレクション

このカテゴリでできること

Publishing with GitHub Pages is simple once it is configured, but domain rules, CNAME placement, and build output checks can cause 404s or broken deployments. This collection groups the tools that matter before and after you push.

向いている作業

  • Setting up a custom domain on GitHub Pages.
  • Checking static output before pushing a release.
  • Preparing CNAME, robots.txt, sitemap, and favicon files for a new site.

FAQ

github pages publishing workflowのFAQ

What order should I use these tools?

Start with the CNAME helper to set up your domain, then the SEO checklist to verify pages, then the robots.txt builder for crawler rules, then responsive image markup for media, and finally the SPA 404 helper if your site is a single-page app.

Do I need all of these for a simple GitHub Pages site?

Not necessarily. A minimal setup might only need the CNAME helper and the SEO checklist. Add the other tools as your site grows or when you notice missing favicons, broken social previews, or crawler issues.
